response.description: A temperature control bath in which a water ice mixture acts as contact medium at constant temperature of 0 degrees Celsius or below if salt solutions are used.
response.label: ice bath

response.description: A temperature control bath in which a dry ice solvent mixture acts as contact medium at a constant temperatures significantly below 0 degrees Celsius.
response.label: dry ice bath

response.description: A temperature unit which is equal to one kelvin degree. However, they have their zeros at different points. The centigrade scale has its zero at 273.15 K.
response.label: degree Celsius

response.description: A temperature unit which is equal to 5/9ths of a kelvin. Negative 40 degrees Fahrenheit is equal to negative 40 degrees Celsius.
response.label: degree Fahrenheit
